description: The Go Vrinda Studio S7 Digital Zikr Counter Ring is a modern, smart and convenient solution for prayer counting, mantra jap, dhikr, meditation and spiritual tracking. Designed for comfort and accuracy, this rechargeable digital finger tally counter replaces traditional mala beads or rosary counters with advanced technology and ease of use. Built with a bright OLED HD display, the S7 counter ring clearly shows your count, date and time in a sharp, easy-to-read format. With an impressive counting capacity of up to 99999, it supports long chanting sessions without interruption. Whether you are performing mantra jap, tasbih, dhikr, naam japa or meditation practices, this digital counter ensures precise and reliable tracking. The one-button smart counting system allows smooth and effortless operation. Simply press to count, and long-press to reset in seconds. The built-in vibration alert provides silent feedback, making it ideal for use in temples, mosques, prayer halls, or quiet meditation spaces.
